scheme_name: Go Green Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in a factory or institute in Gujarat
Applicant must have regularly contributed to the Labour Welfare Fund
The two‑wheeler must be empanelled with FAME‑2 and GEDA
Vehicle must be manufactured in India under the Make in India and Aatma Nirbhar Bharat initiatives
The two‑wheeler must be battery‑operated with a lithium‑ion battery capable of running at least 50 km on a single charge
The vehicle should not require a separate charging station and must be recognized under the Motor and Vehicle Act
benefits_summary: A subsidy of 30% of the purchase price up to ₹30,000 is provided for eligible battery‑operated two‑wheelers, along with a one‑time subsidy for RTO registration and road tax.
